data.body: Investigation: local review skip in ci-pr mode (per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 2) was intentional — CI is supposed to handle review. The gap was that CI never fired (trigger pattern mismatch). Now review-sub-pr.yml fires on story→session PRs (PR #291 + #297, verified PR #296). Defense-in-depth fallback added in per-worktree-review-commit.md to detect pattern mismatches.
